observations.says: from eight o'clock on Friday evening until nine o'clock on Friday evening, Mr. Wicks was in Mrs. Dabney's kitchen
at half past eight on Friday evening, Mr. Wicks was in Mrs. Dabney's kitchen

at nine o'clock on Friday evening, the counting-room door was locked; at nine o'clock on Friday evening, the counting-room key was in the passage
a little after eight on Friday evening, Job Tarrant had the counting-room key; a little after eight on Friday evening, Job Tarrant was in the counting-room
from eight o'clock on Friday evening until nine o'clock on Friday evening, Mr. Wicks was in Mrs. Dabney's kitchen
